transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

I'm just here because... I don't really care about anything anymore. I used to do art classes and go to board-game nights, but I stopped. I don't go hiking or even think about getting back on my soccer team. I just... sit in my room mostly. Everything is just slipping away, I guess.
Do you feel sad most of the time?
Yeah... I guess so. Most days I just wake up with this... heavy feeling. It's kind of hollow in my chest. It just feels like there's no real future for me beyond my apartment walls. So... yeah.
How long have you been feeling this way?
I don't know exactly... it's been a while. Um, I guess it really settled in last summer. So... maybe a year and four months? Something like that. It just hasn't stopped since then.
Do you still enjoy things you used to like, or has the pleasure gone away?
I thought I already said that... I don't care about those things anymore. The art, the games... I just don't care. It's all just gone.
Do you find yourself moving more slowly than you used to or feeling restless and unable to sit still?

Both, I guess... Um, sometimes I just pace. Back and forth from the kitchen to the window... I'll do it until my legs ache. But other days... I don't know. Everything is just slow. Even trying to make coffee feels like... like lifting wet cement.
Have you noticed any significant change in your weight recently?

I guess... yeah. I don't really eat much. Most of the day I just go without... everything kind of tastes like cardboard anyway. Um... my jeans have gotten pretty loose. I've had to start knotting the waistband just to keep them on.
Have you had any thoughts about harming yourself or ending your life?

I... I guess so. Just... having thoughts that I don't really want to wake up anymore. Um... when my friend found me, I guess I had been saying it out loud... that I just couldn't keep living like this. But... yeah.
Have you experienced any strange thoughts or heard voices that others couldn't hear?

Um... yeah. Sometimes. There's... there's a voice. 

It's a woman. She usually comes from the corner of my room. She just... she tells me I ruined everything. That I need to stay inside. It's... it's not like a thought, it's... it sounds just like someone is standing right next to my bed talking to me.
Have you ever had a period of time where you felt extremely happy, energetic, or irritable, and your thoughts were racing?
No... not really. I'm just... tired all the time.
Have you ever had a time in your life when you felt extremely happy or energetic for a while?
Um... no. I... I think I just said, but... no. I don't really remember ever feeling like that. Just... always tired.
Have you had any periods in the last year where you felt completely back to normal, without any of the heavy or hollow feelings you've been describing?

Um... no. Not normal. Since this all started, it hasn't just been... the scary stuff, or being confused. Mostly I just... I've been really depressed. I don't really care about doing anything anymore. It just... it feels like my life is already over.
Have you ever had a period in your life before this started where you felt extremely happy or energetic for a while?
No... I... I don't think so. I don't really remember ever feeling like that.
Have you ever had a time in your life before you started feeling depressed when you felt extremely happy or energetic for a while?
I... no. I think I just answered that. I've never... I haven't ever felt like that.
Have you ever felt this depressed before this episode started?
I... no. Not that I remember. It's never been... this heavy before.
Have you ever felt depressed like this before in your life?
I... didn't you just ask me that? No. Like I said... I don't think I have.
Did you ever have a period in your life before this depression started where you felt extremely happy or energetic for a short time, like a few days or weeks?
I... you just asked me that. About being happy or energetic. I... no. I haven't.
Did you experience any periods of extreme happiness or energy before you started feeling depressed?
I... I feel like we keep going in circles. You keep asking the same things. But... no. I haven't. Just... no.
Have you had more than one period in your life where you felt depressed like this?
I... I don't know why you keep asking me the same questions. I already told you, no. I haven't.
Have you ever felt depressed like this before in your life, excluding the current episode?
I... I don't understand what you want me to say. I just answered this. No... I haven't.
Have you had any periods in your life where you felt depressed like this before the current episode started and then got better without treatment?
I... I really don't know what else to say to you. I keep telling you no. Why do you keep asking it differently? The answer is still no.
